findings.what_is_wrong: The Google Ads conversion snippet on /thank-you is rendered only when marketing consent is already granted. Consent Mode v2 defaults are denied and the CookieYes policy has defaulted marketing storage to denied since 2026-08-15, so a first-time visitor's conversion never leaves the browser.
findings.how_we_know: Source: src/app/thank-you/page.tsx line 41 wraps gtag('event','conversion',{send_to:'AW-8123456789/AbCdEfGhIj'}) in an if (consent.marketing) render condition. Runtime: no request to googleads.g.doubleclick.net as a first-time visitor; one request as a visitor who accepted.
findings.how_to_fix: Render the conversion event unconditionally and let Consent Mode carry the consent state (it degrades to cookieless pings when denied) instead of gating the render on consent; then redeploy production.
findings.agent_task: Edit src/app/thank-you/page.tsx: remove the if (consent.marketing) condition around the gtag conversion call for AW-8123456789/AbCdEfGhIj so the event fires on every /thank-you load. Keep the Consent Mode v2 default block in src/app/layout.tsx untouched. Redeploy production. Verify with analytics_probe_page({ url: 'https://brightside.example/thank-you' }) that the googleads.g.doubleclick.net request appears in as_first_time_visitor.

findings.what_is_wrong: The Meta base pixel (778812345) is present in the project source but absent from the HTML production serves.
findings.how_we_know: Source commit c41e9f2 (2026-08-20T16:05:00Z) adds fbq('init','778812345') to src/app/layout.tsx. Production serves build 9b02a7d, deployed 2026-07-28T02:10:00Z, and neither /contact nor /thank-you made a request to connect.facebook.net or facebook.com/tr in either consent state.
findings.how_to_fix: Deploy production (deploy_site) so the pixel in the source reaches served HTML. The source needs no change.
findings.agent_task: Run deploy_site({ project_id: 'site_brightside_main', environment: 'production' }) after operator confirmation. No code change. Verify with analytics_probe_page({ url: 'https://brightside.example/thank-you' }) that a facebook.com/tr request appears in both consent states.

(1) google_ads, critical, consent-changes-outcome: src/app/thank-you/page.tsx line 41 renders the Google Ads conversion event for AW-8123456789/AbCdEfGhIj only inside if (consent.marketing); remove that condition so the event fires on every /thank-you load and let the Consent Mode v2 defaults in src/app/layout.tsx carry consent state. (2) meta_ads, high, tag-not-deployed: commit c41e9f2 already contains fbq('init','778812345') in src/app/layout.tsx but production still serves build 9b02a7d from 2026-07-28; no code change, production needs a deploy. Both fixes ship in one production deploy. Verify afterwards with analytics_probe_page on https://brightside.example/thank-you: expect googleads.g.doubleclick.net in as_first_time_visitor and facebook.com/tr in both consent states.
